title: FIND EXTREMA IN A CIFTI FILE
description: Finds spatial locations in a cifti file that have more extreme values than all nearby locations in the same component (surface or volume structure).  The input cifti file must have a brain models mapping along the specified direction.  COLUMN is the direction that works on dtseries and dscalar.  For dconn, if it is symmetric use COLUMN, otherwise use ROW.

surface_distance.description: the minimum distance between extrema of the same type, for surface components

volume_distance.description: the minimum distance between extrema of the same type, for volume components

direction.description: which dimension to find extrema along, ROW or COLUMN

left_surface.description: specify the left surface to use

right_surface.description: specify the right surface to use

cerebellum_surface.description: specify the cerebellum surface to use

surface_presmooth.description: smooth on the surface before finding extrema

volume_presmooth.description: smooth volume components before finding extrema

presmooth_fwhm.description: smoothing kernel distances are FWHM, not sigma

low.description: the largest value to consider for being a minimum

high.description: the smallest value to consider for being a maximum

merged_volume.description: treat volume components as if they were a single component

sum_maps.description: output the sum of the extrema maps instead of each map separately

consolidate_mode.description: use consolidation of local minima instead of a large neighborhood
